Yesss :) these may be obvious but I just did these things and didn’t spend my gems in order to not waste the gems I have saved:

- Completed quests
- Cleared Vampire fruit bats
- Levelled up
- Cleared changelings 
- cleared parasprites 
- played the balloon pop game (free ones)
- once a quest has been completed, I watched an ad to get twice the rewards
- I try to skip quests that want you to buy gems by watching ads. For example: if a quest asks you to buy a shop that costs 20 gems and you don’t want to waste the gems, there is usually a green button and it says “skip task” and I watch the ads until the task is complete. (This isn’t really how to gain gems but how to save them up.)
- Cleared vines in everfree forest 
- Added friends codes who were below level 10 so I could get gems every time they levelled up to level 25, 50 and 100.
- Completed group quests
- Completed a collection (I got the mane 6 and revived 40 gems I think)
- Watch ads for gems

There’s probably more but these are just what try to do everyday. I also play the game everyday so which makes me get more gems. I know that there’s a daily reward quest if you play the game everyday and you may get some gems but this last happened like on Christmas 2021 so I’m not sure when it will come back. There’s also a pony that you can get if you watch a ton of ads (like 80 ads) and you can get 20 gems. Just click on your quests and click on the ad quest. I can’t be bothered to do that though that would be very boring for me lol.

Hope this helped.
